firstPlayerRule: Players choose a starting player by any method they like, then give that player the Starting Player token.
clarifications: The first civilization cards are chosen starting with the player to the right of the starter and continuing counterclockwise.
Later, a player can take the New Starting Player action to receive the token for the next round; otherwise it stays with the previous starter.
